description: At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day. We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. Taking ownership and driving impact  Being open to change and feedback Being passionate about our mission and our customers.  Your Mission As a Catawiki Live Business Developer, you will help scale Catawiki Live, a key growth initiative that extends Catawiki’s auction experience through live shopping events. You will build and develop a pipeline of high-potential sellers, support their onboarding, and help them grow successfully on the platform. Working closely with commercial teams, category experts and other stakeholders, you will contribute to sustainable revenue growth by supporting sellers throughout the early stages of their journey on Catawiki Live. What You’ll Do Identify, qualify and develop new seller leads through online research, outreach and collaboration with sales representatives and category experts. Activate high-potential sellers to join Catawiki Live and expand the seller pipeline. Onboard new sellers to Catawiki Live, helping them understand how to succeed in the live auction format. Support a smooth pre- and post-live experience for newly onboarded sellers. Collaborate with category experts and internal stakeholders to develop growth plans for sellers. Build educational content for the Catawiki Live Seller Academy to help sellers maximise success through live auctions. Develop category knowledge to better support sellers and identify growth opportunities. What You’ll Bring A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business or a related field. At least 1 year of relevant experience, including internships or similar commercial roles. A strong commercial mindset with excellent communication skills. An entrepreneurial approach and strong problem-solving abilities. An interest in online marketplaces, with an affinity for collecting or understanding seller communities. Experience using Google Workspace tools, including Google Sheets and Google Slides. Fluency in English and Dutch with additional European languages, and knowledge of live streaming platforms considered a plus. How We Work Collaborate closely with sales teams, category experts and other internal stakeholders. Support sellers throughout the early stages of their journey on Catawiki Live. Contribute to a cross-functional growth initiative focused on scaling Catawiki Live. Learn

description: RDQ426R402 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world’s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world’s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. As a Product Manager on the Lakeflow Jobs team , you will shape the future of data-aware orchestration on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Jobs is Databricks’ built-in orchestrator, managing hundreds of millions of workloads every week with 99.95% reliability. It powers ETL, AI/ML, BI, and streaming workloads for thousands of customers. Your focus will be on evolving control-flow capabilities, authoring experiences, and observability features that allow customers to productionize workflows with best practices like source control, code promotion, and system observability. This role requires a deep understanding of orchestration workflows , data pipelines , and service reliability. You will work closely with engineers, designers, field teams, and customers to define the roadmap, drive adoption, and ensure Jobs is the best-in-class orchestration platform for modern data and AI teams. The impact you’ll have: Define strategy & roadmap: Set vision and priorities across orchestration, triggers, authoring, and observability. Translate customer needs into features and integrations that accelerate Lakeflow Jobs adoption. Drive metrics & observability: Define success metrics for adoption, engagement, and developer efficiency. Use data to guide roadmap decisions and refine the product experience. Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with global engineering, field engineering, solution architects, and external partners to deliver impactful features and integrations. Champion customer needs: Talk to hundreds of customers, understand their journeys, and advocate for features that reduce friction in authoring, monitoring, and orchestrating workloads. Own the product lifecycle: Write PRDs, release notes, and documentation, and drive launches that ensure customer and business success.
